name: @wasla/marketing
description: The marketing site (Astro 7, static). FE-1: one placeholder home per locale and the 404; no script at all.

scripts.build: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && node scripts/write-headers.mjs dist
scripts.typecheck: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check --minimumFailingSeverity warning && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
